moderation.queueSubtitle: Reports filed in this campaign. Evidence is held separately and every read is logged.
moderation.mineSubtitle: Reports you have filed. You can see their status, but not the evidence held for review.
moderation.dmOnlyHint: You can still see the reports you filed yourself below.
moderation.emptyHint: Nothing has been reported in this campaign.
moderation.emptyMineHint: Use the Report action on a comment or note to raise a concern.
moderation.integrityTamperedHint: This snapshot no longer matches its recorded hash and no redaction was logged. Treat it as unreliable and escalate.
moderation.evidenceNotice: Opening this records who read it and when.
moderation.evidenceReporterSupplied: Supplied by the reporter — the server did not observe this content.
moderation.escalatedNotice: This report has been escalated for server-admin review and is no longer handled here.
moderation.escalateOwnHint: Send this to the server administrators instead of your DM.
moderation.resolveNoteHelp: Recorded in the audit log alongside the outcome.
moderation.muteHoursHelp: Leave empty to mute indefinitely until you lift it.
moderation.reportIntro: Your DM will review this. A tamper-evident copy of the content is saved now, so it can still be reviewed if it is edited or deleted.
moderation.reportDetailsHelp: Anything that helps whoever reviews this understand the context.
moderation.reportContentHelp: Paste or describe it — the server has no stored copy of this to snapshot itself.
moderation.reportSentBody: أصبح هذا الآن في قائمة الإشراف لدى الـ DM، حيث يراجع البلاغات. لا يُرسَل أي تنبيه، لذا قد يمرّ بعض الوقت قبل أن يطّلع عليه. شكرًا لك على الإبلاغ.
